newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/39b665c07ea20af0dd35c23daf1ec096e839fe71.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following Season 5, this update shares our latest progress reducing disruptive voice behavior across [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone,[/i] along with ongoing work to support positive multiplayer experiences players already create in matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a5aaa247adc0777abcf7283efcfcb5451fa1cab.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Continued Progress Reducing Disruptive Behavior[/h3][p][/p][p]Reducing disruptive interactions is a priority for [i]Call of Duty[/i]. We continue improving the systems that help identify, review, and act on Code of Conduct violations so players encounter fewer disruptive interactions in their matches.[/p][p]In the first 6 months after Black Ops 7’s release, continued investments in proactive moderation and system improvements helped drive lower disruptive voice behavior in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] compared with similar [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Warzone[/i] windows:[/p][list][*][p]~40% reduction in players exposed to harmful voice interactions.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]~50% reduction in disruptive voice offenders.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]~16% reduction in repeat voice offenders.[/p][/*][/list][p]These results reflect ongoing work across [i]Call of Duty[/i] teams to detect disruptive behavior earlier, improve moderation efficiency and effectiveness, and reduce disruptive voice interactions players encounter in matches. Harmful behavior can make it harder to coordinate with teammates and reducing those encounters helps more players spend more time playing instead of dealing with disruptive interactions.[/p][p]Our work also includes research collaborations that help us better understand how disruptive interactions appears during live matches and where we can continue improving.  One example is our recently published collaboration with Caltech, which explored player behavior at scale and to help inform future improvements. You can read more about this work at [url="research.activision.com"]research.activision.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]This work is ongoing. As disruptive behavior continues to evolve, our team will continue refining our systems, reviewing enforcement outcomes, and improving how we respond. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dcfda1c393d54a760474a9157390abf320032f2a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Positive Play: Supporting Better Teammate Moments[/h3][p]Reducing disruptive behavior remains one part of supporting a healthy multiplayer experience for the Call of Duty community. We do this through proactive detection, player reporting, enforcement, and ongoing improvements to our moderation systems. Positive Play is not about changing what makes Call of Duty competitive. It complements that work by understanding the moments that help players work better together, stay connected with their squad, and feel like they had a better match experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What do we mean by Positive Play?[/b][/p][p]One way we study Positive Play is through prosocial behavior, which we define as actions or interactions that benefit other players or the community.[/p][p][/p][p]That includes moments like:[/p][list][*][p]Supporting teammates through communication[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reviving or buying back a teammate[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Thanking a teammate after a revive or buyback[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sharing resources or loot[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Using voice or text chat to call out enemy positions or Points of Interest (POI) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Using voice or text chat to call out harmful interactions[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]These interactions are already a regular part of the multiplayer experience. A recent case study examining prosocial voice interactions in Call of Duty: Warzone found:[/p][list][*][p]~ 22% of players encountered at least one supportive voice interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]~ 6% of players initiated at least one supportive voice interaction. Because these interactions often involve multiple teammates, a single positive moment can reach many players during the same match. [/p][/*][*][p]~66% of matches containing prosocial voice interactions also included at least one cooperative action, such as reviving or thanking another player.[/p][/*][/list][p]The findings suggest that supportive communication often occurs alongside cooperative gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also observed early signals in select [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] modes that suggest certain positive teammate interactions are associated with players choosing to continue playing together in after a match. Recent analysis in select Call of Duty: Warzone modes found that receiving a thanks from a random teammate was associated with players continuing to play together in the next match.[/p][p]The takeaway is that positive communication often shows up in the same moments where teamwork matters most. Supporting these positive interactions complements our work to reduce disruptive behavior while both contributing to a better multiplayer experience for players. These learnings help us better understand which moments matter to players and how future experiences could make positive play easier to recognize, more visible, more connected to the way players already work together in matches, and more rewarding to players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/006808bd275cbe801373d6c6325baf6b77cdad81.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Looking Ahead[/h3][p]Helping improve the multiplayer experience requires both reducing disruptive behavior and supporting positive player interactions. Behind the scenes, this work reflects a long-running effort of our teams continuing to invest in proactive detection, moderation and enforcement, measurement, and ongoing system improvements, alongside academic research, and industry collaboration across Player Trust & Positive Play. We will continue improving our moderation systems, evaluating positive player interactions, and using data-informed insights to guide future investments to build a stronger understanding of how player behavior shapes multiplayer games. [/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll continue sharing our progress as our work evolves. Our commitment remains the same: creating a Call of Duty experience that’s competitive, fair, and fun for all.[/p][p] [/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 PC Trailer, Tech Updates, and More
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8fb9728a184db1cec6037e2321fe155c9f280692.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for the release of [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] on PC arriving October 23 on Steam. In close partnership with Infinity Ward, [i]Call of Duty[/i] PC lead developer Beenox is working on delivering the best experience possible across a wide variety of setups. [/p][p]Take a look at what’s coming in the official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] PC trailer:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zuzBlGUDxx4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]PC Hardware: Designed for Many Specs[/h2][p]The Beenox and Infinity Ward teams have been working hard to ensure that Modern Warfare 4 performs well on a variety of PC system specs. Though the game looks great on high-end graphics cards, it isn’t just designed for players with the best GPUs. With 800+ customization options across graphics, gameplay, input devices, interface, and more, you can dial into the exact settings that work best for your setup.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/516e48a3700faf1ba14f96531c62a515d066f144.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some of the major PC features we’re supporting include:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized Hardware Support: [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] runs on most hardware while also seamlessly scaling up to crisp graphics and ultra-smooth, high FPS gameplay on higher-end setups. The game automatically configures settings based on your hardware.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Display Optimization: From 4K to 1440p to 1080p, from standard to Ultrawide, expect support for displays of all shapes and sizes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cutting-Edge Upscaling: Choose from a range of upscaling and frame generation technologies including AMD FSR Redstone, NVIDIA DLSS 4.5, Intel XeSS 3, and Filmic SMAA T2X.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]RICOCHET Anti-Cheat: A Multi-layered Anti-Cheat system combines server-side detections, hardware-based protections such as TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot integration, deep investigations, and legal action to combat the cheating market and keep gameplay fair. In addition to RICOCHET Anti-Cheat, expect account security with 2FA and email verification.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sub-frame mouse polling: Increased mouse precision for aiming, in addition to support for a variety of input devices.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Visibility and Target Acquisition[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38bb884d237e6d123791eb865fc0b8f269767c13.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, significant progress has been made on improving visibility and clarity to the game across all platforms including PC, with the following updates:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enhanced FOV[/b][/p][p]Available exclusively on PC, Enhanced FOV uses physically accurate lens effects to increase the field of view near the edges of your monitor without affecting the center FOV, a useful feature for players who prefer a smaller FOV but still want the awareness advantage of a wider field of view.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Greater Player Visibility[/b][/p][p]With HDR10+, the game engine interacts with your screen’s brightness settings in real time, adjusting contrast and lightning as needed for optimal clarity without the need to adjust manual sliders.

Additionally, expect new visual settings and setting values that lead to a sharper gameplay experience including:[/p][list][*][p]New sharpness slider global to any upscaler[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New shading quality[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Filmic SMAA T2X settings[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved GFX settings such as:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Screen Space Reflections [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Shadow Filtering Quality [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Occlusion and Screen Space Lighting [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual Clarity in Combat: Weapon VFX Masking[/b][/p][p]Muzzle effects are dynamically masked at the point of aim, keeping targets visible without reducing visual intensity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Depth of Field[/b][/p][p]The Depth of Field setting will now be split between two settings: World Depth of Field and Weapon Depth of Field. With this change, players who prefer a sharper world can still experience the realistic effects of aiming with a weapon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Bloom[/b][/p][p]In previous games, bullets fired used to hit randomly within a certain area of effect. In Modern Warfare 4, bullets are now fired based on the weapon’s barrel position, leading to more intuitive, precise, and realistic aiming, in both ADS and hipfire stances. Optionally add a Laser Attachment to your weapons to help you read where these shots are traveling.[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance and Settings[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7dd7e6a3c4d78b01e632520cd595d14750a9ad3b.jpg"][/img][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is raising the bar for PC performance, targeting 90 FPS at Recommended Specs without compromising visual quality. Players can enjoy a smoother, more responsive gameplay experience, while the broad range of supported hardware keeps the game accessible to players with more modest setups.  [/p][list][*][p][b]90 FPS at Recommended Specs:[/b] Enjoy buttery smooth gameplay with 90 FPS support at Recommended Specs without manual setting tweaks to achieve this.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ray Tracing in All Modes:[/b] Ray Tracing is supported in Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ, enhancing graphical immersion with hyper-realistic reflections, shadows, and lighting. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution Scaling Technique:[/b] Choose from several upscaling solutions based on your graphics card to maximize performance with the following options: [/p][/*][*][p][b]NVIDIA DLSS 4.5:[/b] NVIDIA RTX technology which uses a deep learning neural network to boost frame rates and generate beautiful, sharp images. [/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD FSR Redstone:[/b] Cutting edge upscaling technique developed from the ground up to produce high resolution frames from lower resolution inputs. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Intel XeSS 3:[/b] Super Sampling technology using machine learning to deliver more performance with expectational image quality. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Filmic SMAA T2X:[/b] Default post process effect to reduce perceived jagged edges in the final rendered image.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Benchmark Tool[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e723455a7f60d9b415627b15132f70adaa5c7a4.jpg"][/img]Zero in on performance stats with the built-in Benchmark Tool, which will run a simulated multiplayer sequence that tests your system’s, displaying real-time information including Average FPS, CPU, GPU, Ping, and Input Latency. Get a more detailed overview following the sequence with a breakdown on stats across all zones and in each individual zone, including setting suggestions to improve your system’s performance in different gameplay scenarios.

[/p][h3]Faster Time to Play[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6fd3b187b1bfb50715695d141d9b5aef919bc168.jpg"][/img]Spend less time waiting and more time playing with features that get you into the game faster, including:

[b]Advanced Shader Delivery[/b]

Previously known as “Shader Preloading”, get straight to playing with Advanced Shader Delivery (ASD), enabling MW4 to launch faster by delivering precompiled shaders ahead of time across supported PC platforms. 

A few minutes of preparation before launch day will mean less time managing downloads, updates, and setting up. For the best experience, download and install the XBOX PC app ahead of time no matter what your PC platform, so ASD can deliver your precompile shaders at game install and throughout live updates. Also remember, don’t skip downloading the latest graphics drivers.

Note: Installing the XBOX PC app is only necessary if you wish to utilize ASD on a supported PC platform.

[b]Update Doesn’t Require Restart, Faster UX Flow[/b]

Updates no longer require restarts during game boots, reducing the friction of loading up the game after an update, though you can still expect a restart when an update goes live when you’re actively in-game. Expect this to occur between matches. We’ve also created a faster user experience flow by streamlining the game menus in favor of getting into a match as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][h2]For the PC Crowd: New Collateral Mode[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6056920696af684862d410de82a9f094f1b3b0c0.jpg"][/img]Experience Call of Duty in a completely new way with Collateral, a new Multiplayer game mode designed for fans of Search and Destroy and those from the more competitive community.

In Collateral, every dollar counts and every decision matters. Teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites, and all players start with a Pistol and earn in-game cash throughout the match to spend on upgrades between rounds.

Eliminate enemies and play the objective to earn cash which you can spend on the following upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Armor and Perks: Armor Vest, Battle Hardened, Lethal Reach, Fast Hands, Ghost[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment: Flash Grenade, Molotov Cocktail, Frag Grenade, Stim, Smoke Wall, Riot Shield[/p][/*][*][p]Pistols: Silenced Pistol, Revolver, Akimbo Pistols, Power Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Issue: Shotgun, Light Machine Gun, Marksman Rifle, Silenced SMG, Agile SMG[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 1: Semi Auto Rifle, High Damage Rifle, Burst Rifle, Silenced Rifle, Sniper Rifle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Team Buy: UAV[/p][/*][/list][p]Youlose your loadout if you die, and all earned money is kept between rounds. Respawns, Killstreaks, automatic health regeneration, and custom loadouts are all disabled. Use the limited tools available to you and make smart purchases to improve your odds in the high stakes, single life gameplay of Collateral. Look for further detail on this mode closer to launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]PC Preloading[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b4ad3c3d40080d90582095a6e2757d7cbfc882d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Players who pre-purchase Modern Warfare 4 digitally on PC can preload the game ahead of its launch date. Preloading on PC only begins October 15 at 9AM PT:[/p][list][*][p]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full game releases on October 23 at midnight local time. [/p][p][/p][h2]Official PC System Requirements [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/23f5d8263dd145829b990d999b6a7170edcd3bef.jpg"][/img][b]Minimum[/b]

Minimum specifications needed to play Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4:

•	OS: Windows 10 64 Bit (latest update)
•	CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or Intel Core i5-6600
•	RAM: 8GB
•	Video Card – AMD: Radeon RX 470
•	Video Card – NVIDIA: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / 1060
•	Video Card – Intel: Intel Arc A580
•	Video Memory: 3 GB

[b]Recommended[/b]

Recommended specifications to run at 90 FPS in multiplayer on High graphics settings:

•	CPU – AMD: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
•	CPU – Intel: Intel Core i7-8700K
•	RAM: 16 GB
•	Video Card – AMD: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
•	Video Card – NVIDIA: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti
•	Video Card – Intel: Intel Arc B580
•	Video Memory: 8 GB

•	Network: Broadband Internet connection
•	Sound Card: DirectX Compatible


[b]Ray Tracing Specifications[/b]
Ultra specs to run with High quality Ray Tracing at 4K upscaled:

•	OS: Windows 11 64 Bit (latest update)
•	CPU – AMD: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
•	CPU – Intel: Intel Core i7-10700K
•	RAM: 32GB
•	Video Card – AMD: Radeon RX 9070 XT
•	Video Card – NVIDIA:  GeForce RTX 5070 Ti

[b]Recommended Drivers[/b]

[b]Additional Notes[/b]
•	TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are required to play Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on PC. Other security measures may be enforced. Learn more at [url="https://support.activision.com/tpm"]https://support.activision.com/tpm[/url][/p][p].
•	Intel ARC GPUs require Resizable Bar. More information here.

[b]Notes and global specifications:[/b]

[/p][h2]Preorder Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d07898fcd93ae00b4bcff68263420b17e1fd8a2.jpg"][/img]Secure your preorder now to get into Campaign Early Access* starting October 16 plus get the Hunter Killer Operator Park and the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack. 

Get the Vault Edition for more, including the Hostile Alliance and Special Forces Operator Packs, the Signature Weapon Collection, one season of BlackCell**, and a DMZ Deployment Bonus. 

[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]* [/i][/b][i]Actual Play Time Subject to Possible Outages and Applicable Time Zone Differences. Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.[/i][/p][p][i]** BlackCell, Battle Pass, Call of Duy Points and Tier Skips will be accessible in Modern Warfare 4 upon availability of the Season 1 Battle Pass in-game. newsitems.title: Джейсон Шрайер раскрыл подробности отменённого проекта Bungie - песочницы во вселенной Destiny под названием Payback
newsitems.contents:
Согласно отчёту Bloomberg, Bungie в течение некоторого времени работала над игрой-песочницей во вселенной Destiny. Проект, возглавляемый Люком Смитом и Марком Ноузворти, получил название Payback. По описанию Шрайера, это должен был быть «будущий» Destiny — с той же вселенной, но, возможно, без привычного названия франшизы.

Структура игры значительно отличалась от того, к чему привыкли фанаты Destiny. Шрайер сравнил Payback с Genshin Impact: акцент на героях, открытый мир, исследование и решение головоломок. Игровой процесс строился вокруг этих элементов, а не вокруг привычных шутерных механик.

Одна из ключевых идей Payback — привлечь более молодую аудиторию, которая ещё не была знакома с Destiny. Средний возраст игроков франшизы постоянно рос, а Destiny 2 плохо справлялась с привлечением новичков из-за сложной системы адаптации и удаления контента.

«В Payback было много отличий, но одна из идей заключалась в том, чтобы привлечь более молодую аудиторию, новую аудиторию, ту, которая ещё не была в самом центре вселенной Destiny, потому что средний возраст игроков Destiny постоянно увеличивался».

Payback был отменён летом 2024 года. Официальные причины не называются, но решение совпало с общей перестройкой стратегии Bungie и сложностями внутри студии.

Несмотря на отмену Payback, Bungie недавно подтвердила, что «не собирается заканчивать с Destiny». Студия анонсировала возвращение удалённого контента Destiny 2, включая кампании Red War и Forsaken.

«Мы понимаем, что удаление этих элементов оказало долгосрочное влияние на доверие игроков к Destiny и их удовольствие от игры. Destiny 2 — это больше, чем просто контент. Это место, где игроки вместе создавали воспоминания, заводили прочные дружеские отношения и делились опытом, который оставался с ними на протяжении многих лет. Мы не можем изменить принятое нами решение, но мы можем признать его последствия и приложить усилия, чтобы исправить ситуацию, восстановив эти важные части истории Destiny».

Однако студия предупредила, что возвращение контента займёт время: движок Destiny 2 сильно изменился после выхода Beyond Light, и старые зоны потребуют серьёзной адаптации — освещения, сражений, противников и игровых систем — под современные стандарты.

Параллельно Bungie продолжает работу над Marathon — PvPvE-шутером с элементами эвакуации. Следующее крупное обновление выйдет в декабре и добавит режим командного боя насмерть, социальное пространство и отдельный PvE-режим. Студия обещает «более глубокий опыт выживания», который выйдет «за рамки жанровых ограничений».

Таким образом, даже после отмены Payback Bungie сохраняет амбиции в отношении Destiny и продолжает экспериментировать с новыми форматами.

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 1 Adds a New Operator Skin Toggle
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da1eca7b27f8f3e8b37f8072c5a1bf1608675da3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the last few years, [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i] has brought together Operators, weapons, and experiences from across recent [i]Call of Duty[/i] titles in one shared experience. We know some players enjoy that variety, while others would prefer [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] feel more aligned with the world of the latest release, including the upcoming [i]Modern Warfare® 4[/i].[/p][p]With the launch of the next chapter of [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], we aim to support both player preferences. Starting with Season 1 of Modern Warfare 4, we’re giving players more control over how [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] looks and feels with a new Operator Skin toggle function.[/p][p][/p][h3]Operator Skin Toggle in Call of Duty: Warzone[/h3][p]This all-new filter has been built specifically for the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] chapter, giving players more control over the Operator Skins they see in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] only. When toggled on, the filter displays only [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Operators in the game, giving players the choice to see other Operator Skins.[/p][p]How does the toggle impact what you see in a match?[/p][p]When the toggle is [b]ON[/b]:[/p][p]•	You’ll see a [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Operator in place of any Operator or Operator Skin from another [i]Call of Duty[/i] title (such as Black Ops 6) that's been equipped by another player. This applies to enemies, party members, and squadmates, both in the lobby and during a match.[/p][p]•	Your own equipped Operator will not change. You’ll continue to see the Operator you selected, even if it’s from another title.[/p][p]The toggle only impacts your game, not the experience of others, and will be [b]OFF by default[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Operators and Weapons from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i], [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], [i]Black Ops 6[/i], and [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will remain available in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] starting with Season 1, including the Skins, Blueprints, and Camos you’ve earned and purchased for them. The collection you’ve built remains yours to use, and existing plans for Carry Forward for previous titles are not affected with this update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Carry Forward Plans for Call of Duty: Warzone[/h3][p]All weapons from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] through [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will continue to be accessible through the Legacy tab in the Loadout menu of [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. While these Weapons remain available to use, Gunsmith functionality and prior Custom Loadouts will not be supported for legacy Weapons or legacy Blueprints. However, these won’t be left as base Weapons without Attachments; instead, a five-attachment version of each legacy base Weapon will be available, as well as any Blueprint for a legacy Weapon with their existing Attachment setups.[/p][p][/p][p]Our goal for this chapter of [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] is for the weapon meta to feel distinctly rooted in Modern Warfare 4, while preserving access to nostalgic choices that players know and love. Raven Software will continue to deliver on its commitment to balancing weapons on a biweekly basis, keeping the MW4 weapon lineup fluid and interesting throughout each season.[/p]

newsitems.title: В Destiny 2 вернется вырезанный контент, но Bungie не планирует возвращаться к регулярным обновлениям
newsitems.contents:
Bungie собирается вернуть в Destiny 2 значительный объём ранее отключённого контента, однако это не означает полноценного возвращения игры к прежней модели поддержки. Согласно отчёту Forbes, команда не планирует возобновлять регулярный выпуск крупных обновлений и нового контента.

Речь идёт о кампаниях, рейдах и миссиях, которые ранее были удалены в рамках системы vaulting. После запланированного возвращения они станут бесплатно доступны всем игрокам, в том числе тем, кто не владел ими до отключения. Таким образом, Bungie намерена существенно расширить доступный контент без необходимости покупать старые дополнения.

При этом, судя по информации Forbes, возвращение Destiny 2 связано именно с восстановлением уже существующего содержимого, а не с запуском нового цикла активной разработки. Поддержка игры, вероятно, продолжится на уровне, необходимом для работы восстановленных кампаний, рейдов и миссий, но крупных новых обновлений ожидать не стоит.

Сезонные события также не планируется возвращать в прежнем формате. Оружие и другие награды, которые игроки могли получать во время таких активностей, должны стать доступными через систему разблокировки контента. При этом часть побочных заданий, связанных с сезонными элементами, может не вернуться.

На этом фоне изменение стратегии Bungie выглядит скорее попыткой сохранить Destiny 2 как доступную библиотеку уже созданного контента, чем полноценным возобновлением её активного развития. При этом Destiny 3, согласно имеющейся информации, сейчас не находится в разработке, поэтому дальнейшие планы студии относительно будущего серии остаются неопределёнными.

newsitems.title: Bungie decide their destiny is to do more Destiny after all, pledging to bring back vaulted Destiny 2 campaigns while declaring that Marathon "needs to evolve"
newsitems.contents:
Not long after announcing changes to how they'll handle majorly updating Marathon going forwards, Bungie have reversed course on their decision to stop developing Destiny 2 - a move they followed with layoffs. Promising to bring back vaulted bits of Destiny 2 and declaring that the series is "foundational" to their future. A future which they've kicked off with a lot of grovelling for forgiveness.

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/576f539228171212688a34e304f59274605f6557.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Outlast the Unknown: Black Ops Season 06 is Here![/h2][p][/p][h3]The Haunting[/h3][p]The Haunting returns and there’s nowhere to hide! Season 06 is brimming with evil as fright-filled maps and modes arrive as part of a colossal update that will satisfy your sweet tooth to Halloween and beyond. [/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Roadmap[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53793f7b90276244fa77960d27c24cb7bce6ce93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty® Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, Season 06 amps up the scares with Haunted Hollow, where cosmic horrors and a Ghost Train infiltrate the small-town Resurgence map. In Multiplayer, rack up the kills in the Quantum and Bloodstead maps, Hordepoint mode, and face off on Zombies locations in MP during T.E.D.D. Trials. Conjure a terrifying foe in Endgame’s Forbidden Summoning Event as night descends upon Avalon and face off against pumpkin-headed hordes in Zombies across a slew of grisly new content. [/p][p]Brave the horrors with an assortment of new Base Weapons earned in the Battle Pass and through in-game events, including the TR51 Para Assault Rifle, the iconic VMP SMG, Arcblade Melee Weapon, and Roc 20mm Special Weapon. Unlock new Attachments through Weekly Challenges, summon the forces of Hell with a DOOM-themed Event and Bundle, and much more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join in for a frightfully good time when Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Season 06 launches on September 17 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Endgame Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Night Falls on Avalon:[/b] The Haunting brings nightfall to Endgame’s Avalon, changing up the gameplay experience as Operators take on Activities and Assignments after dark.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New World Event:[/b] A new guest has arrived with The Haunting. Call upon the darkness in the Forbidden Summoning Event.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Avalon Night (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c11d81bb55b125f5bb2368d5964d9a82c4b50aed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Endgame, night descends on Avalon, plunging Operators into an eerie landscape where Fears, Guild opponents, and other obstacles seek to eliminate squads under the cover of night.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Forbidden Summoning Event (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2574071cdc1074a813fe495600e29f6b8c540f20.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Avalon has a new guest courtesy of The Haunting. Unlock the seals to free an ancient threat in the Forbidden Summoning Event and bring plenty of backup to receive its worthy rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Breach an Arctic computing facility in the frigid Quantum, encounter unexplainable horrors in Bloodstead, and drop into Zombies-themed maps Roadkill, Lost, and Inferno for the competitive T.E.D.D. Trials.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes:[/b] In T.E.D.D. Trials, victory goes to the team who completes the most tasks, featuring 6v6 matchups across three Zombies maps. In Hordepoint, control the objective to turn the undead against your foes, and immobilize the enemy in Freeze Tag.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, including new seasonal rewards.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Quantum (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d34343ee2f5a7fb2e0f25b1f04a572842c704d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Seize upon a Guild quantum computing facility buried within the Arctic ice before its secrets are lost. In this narrow map, Operators must brave the cold and snow across the facility’s frigid outdoor spaces including the Courtyard, Square, and Catwalk, while the map’s interior spaces bring combat to a fever pitch in tight areas like the Servers, Maintenance, Hallway, and the frozen Turbine. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c899e0ec45a73fad051755b475fc2e594a9e33b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Damage inflicted on the structure has revealed new routes and cover, including openings in the roof of the central Tower, giving room for aerial streaks to find their way in. The Tower draws attention with a dangerous play space marked with dense cover, openings on all four sides, and a concealed flanking path in the center. Using speed and precision, work with your teammates to calculate a winning score.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bloodstead (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Retheme, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a37e2b758ebde67f087dd00dc46a7ae51e8a978d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through a forsaken Homestead as an unexplained horror descends on the Mason home. The waters have turned to blood, zombies lurk around the perimeter, and blood trails mark every corner of the map.[/p][p]A body hangs from the rafters in the Corpse House and the Blood Shed, while gore overflows in the Cyst Lodge kitchen. Upstairs, a watchful eye looks over the chaos within. Everywhere you look, horror awaits; tread carefully or risk losing your sanity before the fight is won.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]T.E.D.D. Trials (Launch, LTM)[/b][/p][p][i]New LTM, Zombies Maps Only[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c3634c8ef9aa73283a7bb4e906783a8118a943c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Compete in 6v6 across a variety of T.E.D.D. Trials in this special playlist bringing three iconic Zombies maps into Multiplayer for the first time in Black Ops 7. Fight off the enemy team and wield Ray Guns against the horde as a random set of five T.E.D.D. Trials cycles through rotation! The first team to reach the Score Limit or have the most score by the time limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Roadkill[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf24f35555c337866913b157446877bb45e84ae0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Take on trials by Reba’s Diner in Roadkill, based on the Exit 115 location from Ashes of the Damned.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Inferno[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b72901434bd61efd846bf3552580543646653352.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Brave the heat in the ancestral castle from Kowakujō. Complete trials on this map surrounded by active volcanoes and flowing lava rivers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lost[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6d974ae0d793ab5ee26e2c98743faeef116cc41.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to the remote Eidskallen Lighthouse from Totenreich. Traverse the frigid island and fight to be the first team through each trial![/p][p][/p][p][b]Hordepoint (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning LTM, 6v6[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b0ad058d1e768f6e25d253cf252e4fb84b3afd3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Control and hold the objective to score and to turn the horde against the enemy team. In this terrifying twist on Hardpoint, zombies roam the map, lunging at nearby Operators. When the Hardpoint is neutral, they will attack both teams. When one team controls the objective, the zombies will join them and only attack the opposing team, making Hardpoint control critical to winning the match.[/p][p]Check their eyes if you’re unsure of their current allegiance: red-eyed zombies will attack you on sight, while blue eyes signify that the undead are fighting on your side. Keep a sharp eye on the Hardpoint rotation, because the switch can happen in an instant. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Freeze Tag (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning LTM[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Drop into a 6v6 respawn mode where teams compete to freeze the enemy while keeping their allies in the fight. Downed targets will drop and become encased in ice; only their teammates can free them by damaging the ice. Freeze the entire enemy team for a bonus. Proximity chat is enabled. [/p][p][/p][p]Black Ops 7 Moshpit and More[/p][p]Keep an eye out for additional playlists. including the Black Ops 7 Appreciation Moshpit, featuring a mix of Face Off and Core game modes across top-voted maps from throughout the past year.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0da2f876d9308ed72109bb62bf28ec85cd0eca19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Season 06 Ranked Play Overview[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™. Get details on SR tuning this season with more info arriving in the Season 06 patch notes.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Welcome to Haunted Hollow (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45cfdcf869dda1588d9bb5f3ae19d12bec1e2bf2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Something evil has taken hold of Haven’s Hollow, twisting familiar locations into haunting new discoveries. Uncover sinister changes throughout the town, from the entangled River Boat to the raging fire at the Lumbermill and the Mansion gravity vortex. Cosmic tentacles dominate the skyline, heralding the arrival of unknown eldritch horrors, while evidence of occult activity plagues the darkened landscape.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c69a1da7ea2c5120ac9fcf3ad5308cf2e29444e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to the haunted map in Operation Grave Rot to explore the once peaceful town, now transformed by Halloween and the creatures from beyond.[/p][p][/p][p][b]All Aboard the Ghost Train[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a57b23a6eb5abe611d64f048dd3ec800cb3dabc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To get the goods on the Ghost Train traveling through Haunted Hollow, you’ll first need to find a way to phase the train back into reality. Use your time wisely to reach Supply Boxes, a Buy Station, Mystery Box, and other useful resources before the train returns to its immaterial form. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c85f03e8646ca09852c399274357be1a5c90ff93.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Trick or Treat Pumpkins[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/89bff92b32dcfab312bbb5442d5a4505089a91f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The shops around town have left out festive pumpkins brimming with potential rewards, inviting Operator to take a chance on acquiring valuable loot at the risk of incurring the danger of a trick instead. Rewards include Zombies powerups that grant short-term buffs similar to Perks when activated.[/p][p][/p][p][b]And Other Surprises…[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c84fd25f48c7950ddd9b50e9935e21813c60bf6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Haunting has taken over all of Haven's Hollow. From the gravity defying vortex in the Mansion foyer, to the burning of Lumbermill, to the drained Pond with its exposed eldritch sigils, to the massacre at the Research facility, there's so much to explore, offering new means of traversal, secrets to uncover, and even dark whispers of an ancient ritual on the brink of completion.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Limited-Time Mode (Launch)[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Giant Infected (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]64 Players, Haunted Hollow[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/010a0bc4ffd654590d84924a46cf88d1c275e429.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. Infected on a grand scale in Giant Infected as 64 players descend on Haunted Hollow. Eight random players will be assigned as Infected from the start with the goal of infecting every player in the match while the Survivors fight to construct a DNA Bomb capable of stopping the outbreak in its tracks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Survivors[/b][/p][p]Before matters escalate further than they already have, the survivors must gather DNA samples around the map to build and arm a DNA Bomb that will stop the outbreak.[/p][p]Each Survivor enters the match with a fixed Loadout that can be upgraded multiple times as they earn score from surviving, defeating enemies, collecting DNA samples, and completing activities. Collect enough DNA samples to initiate the bomb sequence. If it detonates, the Survivors win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected[/b][/p][p]Fallen Survivors who are not revived in time will join the Infected team as a zombie with default abilities including unlimited sprint, special melee attacks, fast mantling, wall jumps, and no fall damage.[/p][p]The longer an Infected player survives, the stronger they’ll get, gaining increasing levels of strength via upgrades including faster movement speed, increased health, and access to a super jump. Eliminate Survivors and collect DNA to power up more quickly.[/p][p]Relentlessly pursue the Survivors, keep them from collecting DNA, and should they activate a DNA bomb, work with your fellow horde to shut it down and win the match. newsitems.title: The International 2026 Grand Champions
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/bab4343d906943ef2117ae553347d8f8991ebca3.png"][/img]Congratulations to Team Spirit, Grand Champions at The International 2026. After enduring a challenging year, Team Spirit regained their ultimate form just in time to take a five-game Grand Finals slugfest and claim the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai.[/p][p]Spirit's Group Stage started strong, with 2-0 victories over both Xtreme Gaming and Aurora Gaming. They followed with 2-1 win over Team Liquid that put Spirit just one series win away from qualifying for the main stage. They wouldn't get it. Instead, they served as a stepping stone. First to Team Vision, who dropped Spirit in just two games to secure their own invite to the arena. Next, Nigma Galaxy followed suit, handing Spirit another 0-2 loss to snatch a spot on the main stage and force Spirit into elimination play.[/p][p]Their elimination-round opponent? A scrappy Team Resilience who, despite their lower spot in the standings, had clawed out at least one victory in every series they'd played. This round would be no different. Team Spirit took game one with ease, but Resilience rebounded to force a win-or-go-home game three. There, Team Resilience managed to keep pace for a while, until Spirit pulled away in the back half of the match to secure their spot at The International Main Event.[/p][p]The first obstacle at the arena would be the dangerous Iron Wing -- who'd already taken Group Stage series wins off three teams who'd reached the main stage. It wouldn't matter. Team Spirit clipped Iron Wing to send them spiraling into the Lower Bracket and eventual elimination.[/p][p]The next series wouldn't net Spirit the same results. Team Vision, the foe that had already denied them an easy path to the Playoffs, was waiting for them once more. And the result was mostly the same -- Spirit lost. This time 1-2. This time falling into the Lower Bracket, where Team Liquid was already waiting after eliminating last year's champions. Liquid had a stellar showing in the groups, dropping only one series. But that loss came to this same Team Spirit squad they were again facing, and now Team Spirit wouldn't concede even one game.[/p][p]Spirit flushed Liquid out of the tournament to begin an undefeated run through the Lower Bracket, next bouncing both BoomBoys and Team Yandex with 2-0 statements to reach the Grand Finals against -- who else -- Team Vision, the front-runners that had been blocking Spirit's path every step of the way. The team that had stopped Spirit from skipping the elimination round. That had dropped them into the Lower Bracket to fight for their lives. The team that hadn't lost a single series in Shanghai... was now the one thing standing between Team Spirit and the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Game one was Team Spirit all the way. They looked to be cruising to victory in game two as well, but Vision had other plans, clawing back to even the series at one game apiece. It seemed that Vision might steal the momentum by snatching game three, but Spirit held firm to retake the series lead 2-1, just one win away from the Aegis. Once again, Vision would deny them. Their steady play in game four left no room for doubt -- this series was bound for a winner-take-all game five. And it didn't disappoint.[/p][p]After an hour-long showdown that was still anyone's game until the very end, Team Spirit finally overcame the team that had tormented them throughout the tournament, claiming the Aegis of Champions and crowning themselves the very best Dota team in the world. Three-time winners Yatoro and Collapse, and two-time winner Larl now welcome their teammates not_me and rue into an immortal pantheon.[/p][p]As bearers of the ultimate symbol of victory, these names shall forever be inscribed upon the Aegis of Champions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2026 - Team Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Illia "Yatoro" Muliarchuk[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Denis "Larl" Sigitov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexey "not_me" Kosmynin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexander "rue" Filin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55481652342_4378ab4bed_6k.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][p]If you missed any of the broadcast, or just want to rewatch some of the iconic plays, head over to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/user/dota2"]Dota 2 YouTube channel[/url], where you'll find replays of the entire show. You can also find a collection of photos from the event over on the [url="https://www.instagram.com/dota2/"]Dota 2 Instagram[/url] and even more hi-res shots on our [url="https://www.flickr.com/photos/dota2ti/"]Dota 2 flickr[/url].  As always, we'd like to thank all of the players, talent, and everyone in the Dota community for helping bring this global celebration to life. We've been honored to once again help shepherd this event to the stage, but it wouldn't be what it is without all of you.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]English: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Russian: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Spanish: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url]; Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Dota 2 Heroes Around Shanghai[/h3][p]From August 13 to August 18, multiple Dota heroes will descend upon iconic landmarks across Shanghai, with a giant Aegis of Champions making its grand debut. Meanwhile, several commercial districts have set up check-in spots for fans to visit and collect souvenirs.[/p][p]Check out the landmark details below or visit [url="https://act.dota2.com.cn/2026/shanghaitour"]Perfect World's Shanghai Dota Tour site[/url] for a handy map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dota Hero Landmark Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Wujiaochang Commercial District[/p][/*][*][p]Wujiaochang Guangchang: Aegis of Champions[/p][/*][*][p]Bailian ZX Fun Mall: Queen of Pain, Axe, and Pudge[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza: Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Lujiazui Super Brand Mall (Aug 12-18): Windranger[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai EXPO Culture Park (Aug 13-18): Mars and Shadow Fiend[/p][/*][*][p]Taikoo Li Qiantan (Aug 18–24): Aegis of Champions, Drow Ranger, Crystal Maiden, and Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Check-in Spots: Lujiazui 96 Plaza, New bund 31, Shanghai No. 1 Shopping Center, Expo Place[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Secret Shops[/h3][p]If you're looking to scope out this year's merchandise offerings, our partner stores are already online for both Chinese and international customers.[/p][list][*][p]For China domestic fans: [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For fans everywhere else: [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Secret Shop will also operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last match series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from onsite cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Streams[/h3][p]The strength of Dota has always been its vibrant and passionate community. The International is an expression of that, both the in-person event and the many millions who participate online, those watching and those streaming.[/p][p]Speaking of which: As always, we welcome community streams of the event. There's more detail in [url="https://www.dota2.com/dotatv"]the community stream FAQ[/url], but to summarize: You have a lot of freedom in how to stream your TI commentary the way you and your viewers want as long as your stream is based on DotaTV and your own content, not on someone else's stream (including ours).[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrapping Up[/h3][p]There's obviously a lot going on already, but there's even more info about The International to come. We'll be back soon to provide more details about on-site events, badges, Crimson Witness drops and more as we move closer to the show. Until then, make sure to get those predictions in. We'll see you when groups start.[/p]
